text_block_list.text:
A certain day in a certain month 
at the Tokyo Racecourse

The race track is busy today～! 
Be sure not to get lost.
Well then, let me introduce myself.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm Tazuna Hayakawa, and I'm the secretary 
to the president of Tracen Academy, and 
also in charge of information!
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes ♪ It's an honor to meet a promising 
new trainer like you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: So let's get started with the school guide.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
First of all, please take a look, 
the race is about to begin!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Look… can you hear it, those loud cheers!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A race where horsegirls compete, which 
people all over the world love…

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It's the fanfare of the opening race, 
the stage of your dreams, where you 
and your horsegirls will be going!
